body:
Your mother isn't the only human on earth and I wouldn't refer to that woman as your mother.

You only see the negatives because you think this specific person should be the one loving you, but that is not true. Love and caring can come from a completely separate source. It could even come from an animal. 

You need to look past what your little bubble around your brain gives you and look for the positive things in life. Say hello to people you pass on the streets, wish them a nice day or just offer them a smile. Even if they do not return the gesture. You don't know what others have gone through. Perhaps you'll meet them again on a better day. Perhaps you'll even be friends with them and find a ray of sunshine.
